title: No Recipe Book System
description: A Mod which removes the recipe book system of Minecraft.
body:
This mod removes the recipe book buttom and the recipe system of Minecraft, just like what [Not Enough Recipe Book](https://modrinth.com/mod/notenoughrecipebook) do.
This mod uses a different way to build source. Which means you need to just download one jar to ALL modloaders!

Intergration about Recipe Viewers:
REI: Removed "Disable recipe book" configation
EMI: Remove the option "Default" in configuration "Recipe Book Action"
RRV: Locked option Recipe book as "Toggle RRV"
